title: WPSB/308/2012 of SUKHBIR SINGH RAWAT Vs CHIEF ENGINEER MINOR IRRIGATION DIVISION and ORS.

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition No. 308 of 2012 (S/B)
Sukhbir Singh Rawat .......... Petitioner
 Versus
Chief Engineer
Minor Irrigation Division & others ..........Respondents
Mr. Pradeep Joshi, Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. K.P. Upadhyay, Chief Standing Counsel for the State of Uttarakhand / respondents.

Coram : Hon'ble Barin Ghosh, C. J.
Hon'ble U.C. Dhyani, J.

Barin Ghosh, C.J. (Oral)
 Petitioner remained in the post, fromwhere he has been
transferred, for a period in excess of two years. Normal tenure of
transfer is three years. Since three years have not expired, the present
writ petition has been filed challenging the transfer order. We do not
find any hard and fast Rule, provided in the transfer policy, that a
person cannot be transferred unless three years have exactly expired.
2. In the circumstances, we refuse to interfere. The writ
petition is dismissed.
